title: SonicPulse
description: A professional, high-fidelity music player and reactive visualizer for Minecraft. Stream from any source with a premium, customizable HUD that pulses to your beats.
body:
**SonicPulse** is a professional-grade media control and audio visualization suite for Minecraft. It transforms your in-game audio into a high-fidelity experience, featuring a powerful DSP engine and a stunning, reactive HUD.

## ✨ Features

### 📡 Streaming
Stream your favorite music directly in-game from virtually any source:
*   **Web Services**: Native support for **YouTube**, **SoundCloud**, **Bandcamp**, **Vimeo**, and more.
*   **Direct Links**: Fast streaming for MP3, FLAC, WAV, WebM, and M3U.
*   **Internet Radio**: Live integration for international radio streams.
*   **Local Files**: Play your personal music collection directly from your computer.

### 📐 HUD Layout
A sleek, customizable ribbon that provides full control without cluttering your screen.
*   **Fixed-Slot Positioning**: Your layout stays consistent. Hiding the logo or track info leaves its "slot" empty instead of shifting other elements.
*   **9 Layout Configurations**: Swap the order of the Logo, Track Title, and Visualizer bars to suit your style.
*   **Marquee Display**: Smooth scrolling for long track names.

### 🎨 Visual Effects
Select from multiple reactive background effects that breathe life into your HUD:
*   **Starfield**: A 3D perspective animation where stars burst toward you on every bass hit.
*   **Heatmap & Aura**: Vibrant thermal and glow effects that react to audio intensity.
*   **VHS Glitch**: Add a retro, corrupted aesthetic to your media player.
*   **Pulse**: A clean, rhythmic pulse that follows the beat perfectly.

### ⚙️ Audio Engine
Customize your sound with advanced digital signal processing:
*   **Dynamic EQ**: Adjustable Bass and Treble shelving filters.
*   **Stereo Widening**: Expand the soundstage for a massive, immersive feel.
*   **Underwater Muffle**: A natural, automatic low-pass filter that triggers when you dive underwater.

### 🛠️ Settings
A professional tabbed interface to manage your experience. Track your play history, manage favorites accurately, and fine-tune every visual detail.

---

### **Details**
*   **Environment**: Both Client & Server (Client required for visuals; Server adds broadcasting).
*   **Updates**: Automatic notifications via the official Modrinth API.
*   **Performance**: Optimized for zero frame-rate impact.
